name: IM Mail Form
author: ichimarutokyo

sections.description:
IM Mail Form is a WordPress contact form plugin that lets you build forms with drag & drop and simple point-and-click controls — no HTML or coding knowledge required.

Add and rearrange fields easily, and configure validation rules such as required fields, character limits, and input formats directly from the form editor.

Create multiple forms for contact forms and other purposes. IM Mail Form includes the essential features needed to manage forms on your website, including confirmation screens, automatic reply emails, file uploads, email logs, and spam protection.

Key Features

  • Intuitive drag-and-drop form builder
  • Create and manage multiple forms
  • 11 field types:
    • Text
    • Email Address
    • Phone Number
    • Textarea
    • Select Box
    • Radio Button
    • Checkbox
    • Date
    • File Upload
    • Hidden Field
    • HTML
  • Easily configure validation rules from the form editor, including required fields, character limits, numeric input, and email format
  • Optional confirmation screen before submission
  • Administrator notification emails
  • To / Cc / Bcc settings
  • Automatic reply emails
  • Merge tags for inserting submitted form data into emails
  • File attachments
  • Display a completion message or redirect users to a specified URL after submission
  • Email logs
  • Duplicate existing forms
  • Default template settings for new forms
  • English and Japanese support

Spam Protection

IM Mail Form includes built-in features to help protect your forms against spam and automated submissions.

  • Honeypot
  • Time Trap
  • Rate Limit
  • Cloudflare Turnstile
  • Google reCAPTCHA v2
  • Google reCAPTCHA v3

CAPTCHA is optional, and you can choose the CAPTCHA method to use for each form.

Extend with Add-ons

The core plugin includes the features needed for typical contact forms. Add-ons can extend IM Mail Form for more advanced use cases.

  • Conditional Logic — Show or hide fields based on user input and other conditions
  • Recipient Routing — Route notification emails to different recipients based on submitted values
  • Webhook — Send submitted form data to external services

Add only the functionality you need, from simple contact forms to more advanced form workflows.

External services

IM Mail Form can optionally use the following third-party CAPTCHA services to protect forms from bots and automated submissions. These services are only used for forms where the corresponding CAPTCHA provider has been selected and configured. Forms that do not use CAPTCHA, or for which the selected provider is not configured, do not load that provider’s JavaScript.

Cloudflare Turnstile

When a form configured to use Cloudflare Turnstile is displayed, the visitor’s browser loads the official Turnstile JavaScript from Cloudflare. On final form submission, IM Mail Form sends the Turnstile verification token and, when available, the visitor’s IP address to Cloudflare’s Siteverify service so that the submission can be verified.

  • Official service: https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/
  • Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/policies/terms/
  • Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/

Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3

When a form configured to use Google reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 is displayed, the visitor’s browser loads the official reCAPTCHA JavaScript from Google. On final form submission, IM Mail Form sends the reCAPTCHA verification token and, when available, the visitor’s IP address to Google’s verification service so that the submission can be verified. For reCAPTCHA v3, IM Mail Form also compares the risk score returned by Google with the threshold configured by the site administrator.

  • Official service: https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/
  • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the im-mail-form folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate IM Mail Form through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open IM Mail Form in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a form and configure its fields and email settings.
  5. Add the generated shortcode to a page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the form design?

Yes. You can customize the appearance of your forms using your theme’s CSS or Additional CSS.

Can I send automatic reply emails?

Yes. You can configure automatic reply emails for each form. You can customize the subject and message body and use merge tags to insert submitted form data.

Can I attach files to emails?

Yes. You can add File Upload fields and attach uploaded files to emails. Allowed file extensions and maximum file sizes can also be configured.

Does the plugin store submitted form data?

No. Submitted form data and email contents are not stored in the database. Email logs store only information needed to review email delivery status, such as the date and time, form name, delivery status, recipient information, and sender IP address.

Does IM Mail Form include spam protection? Is CAPTCHA required?

Yes. Honeypot, Time Trap, and Rate Limit protection are enabled by default. You can also configure Cloudflare Turnstile, Google reCAPTCHA v2, or Google reCAPTCHA v3 when needed. CAPTCHA is optional.

Can I create multiple forms?

Yes. You can create and manage multiple forms. Each form can be placed on pages, posts, or other supported areas using its shortcode.

How long are email logs stored?

Email logs are stored for 90 days and then automatically deleted. Submitted form data and email contents themselves are not stored.

Can I show or hide fields based on user input?

Yes. With the Conditional Logic Add-on, you can show or hide fields based on user input and other conditions.

Can I route notification emails to different recipients based on user input?

Yes. With the Recipient Routing Add-on, you can route notification emails to different recipients based on values entered or selected in the form.

Can I use webhooks?

Yes. With the Webhook Add-on, you can send submitted form data to external services when a form is submitted.

Which languages does IM Mail Form support?

IM Mail Form uses English as its default language and also includes Japanese translations. When the WordPress site language is set to Japanese, the plugin’s admin interface and form-related text are displayed in Japanese.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Improved admin menu labels, ordering, and descriptions for clearer navigation.
  • Improved the Add-ons screen and added support for optional add-on detail links.
  • Reorganized the form editor tabs, including a dedicated Webhook tab when the Webhook add-on is active and clearer ordering of mail-related settings.
  • Improved the consistency and accessibility of admin action controls.
  • Added external service disclosures for Cloudflare Turnstile and Google reCAPTCHA.

1.2.0

  • Added support for Cloudflare Turnstile and Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3.
  • Added site-wide CAPTCHA credential settings and per-form provider selection.
  • Improved CAPTCHA verification and submission handling for forms with or without a confirmation screen.
  • Unified the appearance of IM Mail Form administration screens.

1.1.0

  • Added a shared License page (IM Mail Form → License) for IM Mail Form add-ons.
  • Added stable field identifiers so add-ons can reliably reference form fields.
  • Added a filter for add-ons to control field visibility (e.g. conditional logic add-ons), with no effect on sites that don’t use such an add-on.

1.0.2

  • Added WordPress.org screenshots.
  • Added documentation and support page.
  • Fixed confirmation screen compatibility.

1.0.1

  • Added WordPress.org assets.
  • Fixed localized Mail Logs date display.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
